question: Which additional epithets receive obeisance in this continued salutation sequence?
premises: Obeisance is offered to the greenish one.
Obeisance is offered to the lopya aspect.
Obeisance is offered to the ulpya aspect.
inference: Further epithets in the sequence are honored with obeisance.
uncertainties: Meanings of lopyāya and ulpyāya are uncertain.
